positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Drives full-stack development efforts to enhance our enterprise CRM platform, primarily within Salesforce. Collaborates across product and engineering teams to architect scalable features, improve workflows, and streamline customer engagement. Regularly leverages Python for data analytics, process automation, and generating business insights.

positions.title: Senior Applications Systems Developer
positions.description: Led full-stack development of custom mobile and web applications, including an electronic health record (EHR) and CRM system built with Django and AngularJS. Developed and maintained a cross-platform mobile app using React Native to support remote patient engagement. Collaborated with the Arizona Smoker’s Helpline and College of Public Health to deliver secure, user-friendly tools supporting public health initiatives and case management workflows.

company.name: Mel and Enid Zuckerman College of Public Health

positions.title: Information Officer at UA Emergency Medical Services
positions.description: Supported executive leadership with software and hardware recommendations to improve operational efficiency. Designed and implemented a data warehouse serving as a QA/QI and research tool, aggregating data from dispatch, scheduling, and e-PCR systems to support continuous quality improvement. Engineered solutions to parse large, unstructured XML datasets from legacy platforms lacking standardized formats.

positions.title: ARL Core Facilities, Student Software Developer
positions.description: Developed lab-focused Python applications integrating with Clarity LIMS, prioritizing rapid development, clear documentation, and HIPAA compliance. Built REST API-driven tools and contributed to full-stack projects using Django and Vue.js. Notable work includes a secure web portal for hosting JavaScript applets, custom IoT hardware design, and programming laboratory automation robots using Visual Basic. Collaborated closely with researchers to deliver scalable, well-documented software solutions supporting scientific workflows.

positions.title: Bat-O-Matic Protyper
positions.description: Contributed to the development of the Bat-O-Matic, an Arduino-powered sensor array used to study the feeding habits of endangered nectar-feeding bats in the Sonoran Desert. Designed and programmed custom hardware to improve energy efficiency by enabling motion-activated power control. Supported both hardware prototyping and embedded software development to enhance data collection in remote field conditions.
